en.title: This Sea Snake Always Finds Its Way Home. Name It?
en.description: The banded sea krait hunts eels in the sea but spends about half its time on land. Fijian kraits moved 5.3 km to other islands were found back on their home islands, and its tail looks like its head to confuse predators.
